svg.text: Fixing b = 8 slices the family into a periodic section
As input a varies, the fiber Gcd(a, 8) = {g | Div(g) = Div(a) ∩ {1,2,4,8}} jumps among {1}, {2}, {4}, {8}
1. Bundle of Fibers Gcd(a, 8) Over Slice b = 8 (each vertical line is one fiber ⊂ ℕ)
Candidate value g in fiber Gcd(a, 8) →
Varying input a (with second input fixed at b = 8) →
2. Why the Fiber Moves: Common Divisors Div(a) ∩ Div(8) Determine the Singleton
A dependent function (a : ℕ) → Gcd(a, 8) is a section of this bundle: at every column a, its return value must land inside the purple ring {gcd(a,8)}.
